location.section: GOS ed. p. 58, as quoted in Bhattacharya's note to GST 1.1

original.text: hṛdayaṃ jñānaṃ tadeva vajjayoṣit abhedyāpakṣāsvabhāvatvāt tadeva bhagaṃ sarvakleśabhañjanāt
original.edition: Guhyasamājatantra ed. B. Bhattacharya (GOS 53, Baroda 1931), Muktabodha e-text M00360; variant notes removed by the unit; verse number = the unit's count of double daṇḍas in the chapter
original.licence: Muktabodha e-text quoted for reference; terms of use as for the source file

paraphrase: Indrabhūti explains the opening of the Guhyasamāja: 'the heart' is gnosis; that very gnosis is the vajra-woman, being of the nature of the indivisible, and that very (gnosis) is the 'bhaga' because it destroys all afflictions.
notes: Read in the editor's note of the local Guhyasamāja e-text, not in a Jñānasiddhi file; quoted exactly ('vajja-' is the e-text's misprint for vajra-).
